interface.longDescription: Create a readable, self-contained HTML document from a conversation. Brief, Editorial and Report are separate layouts. Every file has an Appearance panel for colour and reading fonts: Inter, Newsreader and IBM Plex Mono, embedded for offline use. Supports image captions, comparison tables, checklists, nested lists, quotes, callouts, highlighted code and footnotes. Readers can save a copy with their chosen appearance or print all sections to PDF. Includes a bundled renderer, layout templates, rich examples and concise formatting instructions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Idea Zone to turn this conversation into a polished, shareable HTML document.

name: idea-zone
description: Create complete HTML documents with images, rich Markdown, separate layouts and offline colour and font controls.
